Name: Dungeon Clutter for Custom Furniture (CF)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[center][/center][size=3]﻿
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

This mod adds all the things you find in dungeons - rocks, ores, plants - and brings them home to your farm!

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder
[/size][/list][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

You can find these statues in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b].

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]-specific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_credits.png[/img]
﻿
Most of the sprites are originally from the game, edited by me.
Packaged for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url].
Please do not re-use or re-share anywhere without my permission
